title: console list: the footer count probe GET data/<object>?top=0 duplicates the total the page's own list request already returns
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Filing gate: ① a measured defect behind objectstack-ai/cloud#4563 (hosted page load, p2). It was measured locally on cloud main `d97754b`, pin `b914e72` (objectstack 18.5.0), with HotCRM 6.4.0 and sample data in a free-plan hosted environment. The readings are in the cloud#4563 os-dev-report (6904212540). The cloud lane files this card; first touch is left to triage.

## Measurement context (shared by the cloud#4563 split)

Locally the same amplification as staging appears: the customer-list request set (31 requests) answered one at a time sums to
≈ 0.5 s of runtime; the same set at once sums to ≈ 7.2 s (≈ 14×; staging reported ≈ 13×). Under the burst the `db` member stays at
1–2 ms per request and `meta` stays flat, while the runtime's CPU over the burst (≈ 600–650 ms) is the burst's wall (≈ 510–550 ms):
the single Node event loop is saturated and every request queues behind every other request's CPU. Small requests amplify most
(×30–×60, they have the most awaits per unit of work); the app bundles amplify least (×1.4–×2, they ARE the queue). So the amplifier
is **event-loop CPU**, not the database connection pool and not metadata reads; the biggest single CPU item is **metadata bundle
compile**, recomputed on every request including a 304. Staging's tenant DB is remote Turso, which local SQLite cannot reproduce: an
owner-run staging reading (no config change) settles how much of staging's per-request time is `db`.

## This card

- Reach: every object list view. Source: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewLiveData.ts` (`dataSource.find(objectDef.name, { $top: 0 })` for `setRecordCount`).
- Reading: list page sends `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account?top=0` and `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account?top=50&sort=…&select=…` in the same layer; both answers carry `total` (9 and 9). This is cloud#4563's "`data/crm_account` ×2" on the current pin.
- Ask: take the count from the list answer's `total` (or let the grid publish it), drop the probe; keep refreshKey behaviour.
- Acceptance: one `data/<object>` request per list page load (cloud#4563 acceptance 2).
